description: CREATES a new contact in a list — this MODIFIES live data (adds a subscriber). `email_address` is required; optionally set `fields` (keyed by field tag), `tags`, and `status`. EmailOctopus: POST /lists/{list_id}/contacts. Returns the created contact.

fields.description: Custom field values, keyed by the list's field tag (e.g. {"FirstName": "Ada"}).

list_id.description: The list's id to add the contact to.

status.description: Subscription status: subscribed, pending, or unsubscribed.

tags.description: Tags to apply to the contact, e.g. ["vip", "beta"].

name: emailoctopus_create_contact
title: Create contact
